blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-verified 2026-08-08 across all six tracked deployments: Ethereum block 25712443, Base 49714630, World Chain 33441485, BSC 114796051, Polygon 91675721, and Gnosis 47624798. Each proxy still resolved to LatamStable implementation 0x9d6266a9167f17ff3dd20f63a474812d0cd47969 and paused() returned false. On Ethereum, Ripio EOA 0x466c02e2cc67b81a696af5afdb61605c41fe247b still held PAUSER_ROLE. The verified implementation routes transfers through ERC20Pausable, so that live issuer role can halt every holder transfer; the Polygon-matched compliance-bearing revision additionally exposes COMPLIANCE_ROLE address blocking, with matching runtime on BSC and Gnosis. This actual global pause (and selective blocking on three deployments) resolves direct access to true even though no current pause was active; UUPS upgrade authority is an additional restrictable path.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Ripio issues wPEN natively on Ethereum, Base, Worldchain, BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis. Ripio's wFIAT Bridge separately burns source WPEN through BridgeDeposit 0x465e642387d3d73a57cdc1368ffa53a800ba5d47 and fulfills destination minting through LimitedMinterBridge 0x46167cb034fec6cec46caed4f61281f5aa0eb0e6 across all 30 ordered pairs. The destination dailyMaxMint is 72.265625 WPEN per chain, but fulfillBridgeMint does not trustlessly verify the supplied source transaction or amount; the full rail is scored here rather than as native Mint Authority.

protocols.name: Ripio wFIAT Bridge (BridgeDeposit + LimitedMinterBridge)
protocols.note: The verified BridgeDeposit source burns WPEN on the source deployment and lets a BRIDGE_OPERATOR_ROLE caller fulfill destination minting through LimitedMinterBridge. Current 2026-08-16 routeConfigs reads show all 30 distinct ordered pairs among Ethereum, Base, Worldchain, BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis enabled.

Issuer-native deployment, verified by Celo JSON-RPC fixed reads at block 76692485 on 2026-09-05: the wPEN proxy's EIP-1967 implementation slot resolves the LatamStable implementation 0x9d6266a9167f17ff3dd20f63a474812d0cd47969, name 'Sol Peruano' and symbol wPEN with 18 decimals, and paused() false. totalSupply is exactly 100 wPEN against roughly 6710969 wPEN on ethereum, so the deployment is dormant with no meaningful circulation at the read; no transfer or activity history is claimed beyond this supply observation. Current hasRole reads rather than constructor calldata show Ripio Safe 0x2b839174fe62466067c22e2a4c8054071f9d8d68 — deployed on Celo with threshold 4 of the same seven owners recorded for the tracked chains — holding MINTER_ROLE, PAUSER_ROLE, UPGRADER_ROLE, and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, while issuer EOA 0x466c02e2cc67b81a696af5afdb61605c41fe247b holds none, unlike the six tracked deployments where that EOA holds the token roles. LimitedMinterBridge 0x46167cb034fec6cec46caed4f61281f5aa0eb0e6 also holds MINTER_ROLE, so the first-party burn/mint rail can mint here; that rail is assessed in the structured Bridge Risk controls, not as this native route.

Current hasRole reads rather than constructor calldata show Ripio Safe 0x2b839174fe62466067c22e2a4c8054071f9d8d68 — deployed on HyperEVM with threshold 4 of the same seven owners recorded for the tracked chains — as the sole identified authority holding MINTER_ROLE, PAUSER_ROLE, UPGRADER_ROLE, and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE: issuer EOA 0x466c02e2cc67b81a696af5afdb61605c41fe247b holds none, and unlike the tracked deployments neither BridgeDeposit 0x465e642387d3d73a57cdc1368ffa53a800ba5d47 nor LimitedMinterBridge 0x46167cb034fec6cec46caed4f61281f5aa0eb0e6 (both deployed on HyperEVM) holds MINTER_ROLE, so no first-party bridge mint path is enabled for this deployment yet.

controls.label: Ripio WPEN BridgeDeposit burn and fulfillment contract

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: BridgeDeposit.depositForBridge burns WPEN from the source holder and emits the bridge deposit; it is not a reserve lockbox. An off-chain operator later calls fulfillBridgeMint, which invokes LimitedMinterBridge.mintTo on the destination.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: BridgeDeposit 0x465e642387d3d73a57cdc1368ffa53a800ba5d47 is the source-side endpoint and LimitedMinterBridge 0x46167cb034fec6cec46caed4f61281f5aa0eb0e6 is the destination minter for all 30 ordered pairs: Ethereum→Base, Worldchain, BSC, Polygon, Gnosis; Base→Ethereum, Worldchain, BSC, Polygon, Gnosis; Worldchain→Ethereum, Base, BSC, Polygon, Gnosis; BSC→Ethereum, Base, Worldchain, Polygon, Gnosis; Polygon→Ethereum, Base, Worldchain, BSC, Gnosis; Gnosis→Ethereum, Base, Worldchain, BSC, Polygon.
routeChecks.rateLimits: Current routeConfigs show all 30 ordered pairs enabled. The fixed fee is 0.05 WPEN for Ethereum-to-other routes, 5 WPEN for other-to-Ethereum routes, and 0.05 WPEN for other non-Ethereum pairs.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The verified BridgeDeposit source exposes issuer-controlled route and fee configuration, pause, fee-collector, and limited-minter controls. Current reads enumerate BRIDGE_OPERATOR_ROLE but do not independently resolve every admin or fee-collector holder. This is retained as an evidence gap rather than inferred away.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: fulfillBridgeMint accepts source chain, source transaction hash, source deposit ID, recipient, and amount from a BRIDGE_OPERATOR_ROLE caller; it checks idempotency and destination limits but does not verify the source transaction or supplied amount on-chain.

controls.evidence: The verified BridgeDeposit source burns WPEN in depositForBridge and allows a BRIDGE_OPERATOR_ROLE caller to fulfillBridgeMint on the destination. Current 2026-08-16 reads on Ethereum, Base, Worldchain, BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis found the same BridgeDeposit address deployed on each route and the two operator EOAs 0x5ca3f8eeba12d83408fc097c2dad79212456f20f and 0xbc924f707ca021f9b220088afe56c85b9cb43085 on every deployment. Live counters included Worldchain block 33795027 recording 3,995 WPEN burned toward Ethereum and 1,784.030778 WPEN minted from Ethereum, and Worldchain block 33795028 recording 1.32686 WPEN burned toward Polygon with the reciprocal Polygon counter; these counters confirm use but do not close the source-burn verification gap.

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: BRIDGE_OPERATOR_ROLE on BridgeDeposit authorizes this EOA to submit fulfillBridgeMint for the reviewed source/destination route mesh.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: The operator supplies the source chain, source transaction hash, source deposit ID, recipient, and amount; BridgeDeposit checks idempotency and LimitedMinterBridge checks the destination daily limit, but no trustless source-burn or amount proof is enforced on-chain.

controls.evidence: At the reviewed 2026-08-16 reads on Ethereum, Base, Worldchain, BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis, BRIDGE_OPERATOR_ROLE on BridgeDeposit included 0x5ca3f8eeba12d83408fc097c2dad79212456f20f. This operator/backend path is a material bridge trust assumption because fulfillBridgeMint does not cryptographically bind the destination amount or recipient to a source burn.
